Marching Cube - an overview | ScienceDirect Topics
The marching cubes algorithm is used to define a polygonal surface by triangulating the external surface of each yarn (Lorensen and Cline, 1987). A front algorithm (Jin and Tanner, 1993) is used to obtain a volume mesh of each yarn.
